routing_policy: Prefer the cheapest candidate that can still answer well. Escalate to a more expensive candidate only when the request truly needs it: writing or debugging code, tool calls, long or complex input, multi-step reasoning, or a task where a wrong answer is costly. Never pick an expensive candidate for greetings, short factual questions, translation, summarisation or formatting.

targets.description: Fast general-purpose models. Everyday requests: explanations, translation, summarisation, formatting, short factual answers.
Free-tier models. Best for throwaway and bulk work: simple rewrites, boilerplate, quick lookups, short chat replies.
Strongest and most expensive models. Code and debugging, tool calls, long context, multi-step reasoning, analysis and anything where a wrong answer is costly.
